name: Pasteur Dropper / Pipette
semanticDescription: A medical and laboratory grade borosilicate glass Pasteur pipette featuring volume graduation rings, drawn liquid column with wetting meniscus, forming capillary pendant droplet, ribbed silicone squeeze bulb, and dedicated laboratory support stand. Includes dual collections: Dropper_Full and Dropper_Section with 180° longitudinal cutaway, internal wall thickness, suction vacuum physics, and technical plaque.
